differences: The paper rejected 6.6% of trials after visual inspection; the deposit has no per-trial exclusion flags, so every trial is a row and excluded_by_authors is False.

The paper gives a 100 Hz Zebris rate; the median interval between the saved time stamps is 9.9 ms (about 101 Hz), because the stamps are the computer's read times, so n_samples and the time stamps are as saved and sample_rate_hz states the nominal 100 Hz.
Eye movement results (latency, pursuit gain, saccade rate) cannot be reproduced: the gaze data are only in EyeLink .edf files that were not converted.
